full_judgment: 2. The instant opposite party No. 1 (real estate developer) as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 218 of 2013 in the court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka praying for declaration allowing it to execute several kabala deeds on behalf of some third party purchaser (who are pro-forma defendant No. 14-24) impleading the defendant No. 1-11 land owners as principal defendant in the suit. The defendant No. 1-11 land owners who although entered appearance by filing written statement however eventually did not appear during trial. Therefore subsequently the matter was heard in presence of the defendant Nos. 1-11 and the pro-forma defendant No. 14-24 third party purchasers. Thereafter a solenama was executed between plaintiff and defendant No.1-11 (developer company) and defendant Nos.14-24 (third party purchasers). In pursuance sole judgment and decree dated 27-7-2015 was passed by the trial court. Being aggrieved by the sole decree passed by the trial court dated 27-7-2015 the principal defendant Nos. 1-11 land owners filed Title Appeal No.6 of 2017 which was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, 1st court, Dhaka. The appellate court upon hearing all parties being the plaintiff, defendant Nos. 1-11, pro-forma defendant Nos. 14-24 third party purchasers dismissed and disallowed the judgment and decree dated 15-5-2017 and thereby upheld the earlier sole decree passed by the trial court earlier.
